notes.title: MOVAFORT Challenge Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=DsjbvLUuRGU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Challenge Mode[/h2]
Create, Play & Share a Challenge with your Own Rules
What Rules ?
[list]
[*]Control Shifting Paradoxes Spawn Rate or Time Acceleration
[*]Buff or Nerf Ultimate attacks
[*]Modify Paradox Guardians Health or make Elite Guardians Drop more Tesseracts
[*]Make Player Wanted in every Village ?
[*]Level Up Quickly or Disable Experience at all
[*]Add one of 60+ Perks and Curses
[*]And Many More...  The Limit is your Imagination
[/list]
[url=https://discord.gg/9D8g8Hj6NE]Remember to Share your Challenge on Discord[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42650420/ec44bb09b2cce98052d1833eea9682b5b8aaa54a.jpg[/img]

[h2]What happens if ?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b](Bad Omen)[/b] You have 1 Health But Also You have Strength of 36 Men
[*][b](Paradox Madness)[/b] Shifting paradoxes are swarming the world & Guardians are a lot tougher But You get a Tesseract for each Guardian destroyed
[*][b](World Class Thief)[/b] You are a master Thief, Wanted in every Village But you are too fast that Villagers Never feel you if you steal from them
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42650420/e7a7ce051af6f2f5d0861ec75735b600a6851848.png[/img]
[h2]New Class: [b]The Thieve[/b][/h2]
While playing as The Thieve
[list]
[*]Enemies Hardly Spot You
[*]Shorter Stealing Cooldown Period
[*]Less Chance to Miss a Pickpocket
[*]Faster Running Speed
[*]Special Ability: Can Open Locked Chests & Gain Mana When you Get Detected (Increases With Level)
[*]You can Unlock this class by creating an OUROBOROS in freeplay mode
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Knight Class now unlocks when player enter the clock tower for the first time, rather than unlocks when player reaches floor 12 in clock Tower
[*]Knight Class Ability (Increased Ultimate Attack Charge Speed) Increased by 20%
[*]Knight Class Ability (Increased Ultimate Attack Damage) Increased by 25%
[*]Explosive Weapons now have a minimum of 2m radius
[*]Reaching Level 36 now gives 12 Upgrade Points rather than 6
[*]When player reachs level 36 it will now says max level & full XP bar
[/list]

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*]In Freeplay the Pinned notification that says Duration to the Nearest Paradoxes, will now display distance for the paradox shockwave to reach player if clock tower rang
[*]Improved Books Performance
[*]Changed How (Longer Potion Duration) works, yes It's been miscalculated all this time. Now at level 36 (Max Upgrade Level) you get 400% Potion Duration & at Curse level 36 (Max Curse Level) you get 25% Potion Duration
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a rare error that occurs when NPC try to Choose a location to meet and talk
[*]Fixed a Critical Bug that cause Books to Display Blank Pages
[*]Fixed miscalculation related to NPC Melee Damage
[*]Fixed an error that sometimes occurs when skipping the first cutscene
[*]Fixed Wrong Text that may appear with biome name when entering a biome
[*]Fixed player being able to open portals too close to anchors
[*]Fixed Paradox Guardians reseting Max HP to 100 after being saved and loaded
[*]Fixed Game Crash when player Reachs level 36
[*]Fixed Books Buttons not working if player opened books using right click on an inventory item then clock tower rings
[*]Fixed Machinegun Sounds not working
[*]Fixed Toxic Damage Sounds not working
[*]Fixed arrows not playing a sound when hitting Tree or Stone or Ore
[*]Truth Glasses not being destroyed after you buy it with Money
[*]Fixed Player getting detected immediately after being seen
[/list]

Loved Challenge Mode and want more ? give me a feedback on Discord.

notes.title: MOVAFORT Community Update #2
notes.notes:
[b]You can Customize Controls[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42650420/71f602aa3a9f911028c9603c23c63f0e414b24fb.png[/img]

[h2]Notes:[/h2]
-This version of MOVAFORT may use more memory (RAM). if it used more than 8GB make sure to report it
-All Game Settings will reset to default on game launch you can backup your settings by doing the following:
[olist]
    [*] navigate to (Steam/steamapps/common/MOVAFORT/MOVAFORT_Data/MOVAFORTDATA/SettingsDataSave)
    [*] copy all the files inside the folder
    [*] Start the game then exit the game after it loads
    [*] paste the filles you copied in same location (Replace the new created files)
    [*] Done, Start the game and enjoy
[/olist]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Add Key Mapping. You can Now Change the Input controls whatever you like. You can access controls menu from main menu or from in game menu
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
    [*]NPCs will no longer keep standing in shop (sell room) when player is outside the building (standing near the building counts as inside the building)
    [*]Improved how NPCs Y Pos is calculated, NPCs will no longer go through ground and stairs
    [*]Improved NPCs path finding and running speed
    [*]Stamina now will regenerate a percentage of max stamina per second rather than a fixed number per second 
    [*]When standing still the stamina regeneration rate is tripled
    [*]If player is wanted and an NPC spotted player from 12 meter or closer then player will be detect by the NPC
[*]Hitting a (Stones or Ores or Trees or Animals) with arrows will now show their hp on screen
    [/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
[list]
    [*]when NPC path is saved it will only save up to 50 points of navigation
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Fixed an error that occurs when saving the game (caused by releasing the memory of all buildings navigation in the chunk but under water building don't have a navigation)
    [*]Fixed a bug that cause shop items (and any other item) to move every time the game is saved and loaded
    [*]Fixed player be able to skip clock tower rooms by pressing (U). this was a debug feature hopefully no one abused it
    [*]Button (Press E to skip cutscene) will no longer appear at the loading of (free play mode)
    [*]Fixed an error that occurs when player load the game if the game saved while he was being attacked by an NPC
[*]Potions that are dropped from dead animals will no longer explode when hitting the ground
[*]Fixed an error that occurs when player throw an item intro future portals
[*]Fixed the problem causing Items to have missing textures
[/list]

As Always feedbacks & Suggestions are welcomed, If you found Any bugs report it on discord and it will be removed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42650420/dc91681737d67957170ca38aaf016e89f509ed5a.png[/img]

notes.title: MOVAFORT HotFix #3
notes.notes:
After Taking your Feedback, Bugs were fixed and some game mechanics were balanced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42650420/effd41e6f9a8052d8e30f08a1b9eddc42cef151f.png[/img]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
        [*]Damage Direction Indicator: an Arc will appear near cross hair telling player from which direction the damage is coming from, this is useful in a situation where an NPC is shooting an arrows at you from far away and you don't where the NPC is.
        [*]Player Can now throw Potions at him self to as an alternative to drinking it, It will give same effect, Just make sure no enemies are nearby because they might get buffed by the potion, Potions with Explosive effect will damage player.
        [*]Potions will now be drained when fast travel by the same duration the fast travel takes
        [*]Potions will not drain when time traveling or when get hit by paradox shock waves
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
        [*]In story mode when paradox shock wave is closer than 1km the distance will be written in meter
        [*]Base thrown Potion effect Radius is Increased from 1m to 3m
        [*]non-Explosive Potion can now affect 2 targets instead of 1 target
        [*]Player can no longer sleep while detected by Robots
        [*]Player can no longer sleep while stealing from the village
        [*]Mana wont Regen as long as a Time portal is open
        [*]Killing Animals now gives from 5 XP to 50 XP Depending on the Animal Health & Attack Damage
        [*]Sleeping and Traveling in Time now resets Steal and Detection(Stealth) Bar
        [*]Detection Bar and Steal Bar now Drops to zero once player fast travel or sleep or time travel
        [*]Robots Rockets Damage Radius increase by 25%
        [*]Mines Damage now Depends on Distance Between player and the mine and count as Explosive Damage rather than physical Damage
        [*]When using (Fire Ball or Lighting Storm or Toxic Cloud) Ultimate Attack you can press Left Mouse Button to exit Ultimate attack View and Return to First Person View but only after 2 second cool down, cool down starts when the ultimate attack starts
        [/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
[list]
        [*]NPCs searching for a free bed to sleep or a free chair to seat will no longer cause a frame drop
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
        [*]Fixed an error that happens when player take an item that was copied by an event's altar
        [*]Fixed a case that let more than 1 NPC to sleep in one a Bed
        [*]Fixed a case that let more than 1 NPC to seat in one a Chair
        [*]Fixed player be able to get infinity Potion duration by time traveling before potion ends
        [*]Fixed player be able to get infinity Potion duration by throwing the potions into themselves instead of drinking the potions
        [*]Fixed Potion Drains during loading screen
        [*]Fixed Thrown Potion Not affecting Enemies or Player
        [*]Fixed an error that happens when NPCs are hunting player down
[/list]

[h2]Misspelled Fixes[/h2]
[b]Hint: Working on a new system for the tutorial rather than popup in your face at random
[/b][list]
[*]Alpha Robot Tutorial: Fixed Grammar mistakes & Replaced the work Bot with Robot
[*]Journey Books Tutorial: Fixed Grammar mistakes
[*]Paradox Guardians Tutorial: Fixed Grammar mistakes & changed (carrying Items from The Future) to (carrying Items from The Past)
[*]Cauldron Tutorial: Fixed Grammar mistakes & Misspelled words
[*]Craft Tutorial: Removed Repeated Sentence (• Axes Do x2 Damage to Trees)
[*]Events Tutorial: Fixed Grammar mistakes
[*]Health & Shield Tutorial: Fixed Grammar mistakes & Misspelled words & Adjusted text size
[*]Local Map Tutorial: Fixed Grammar mistakes & Misspelled words
[*]Send Item to Future Tutorial: Increased Text Size & Fixed Grammar mistakes
[*]Stats Tutorial: Fixed Grammar mistakes & Misspelled words
[*]Stealth Tutorial: Fixed Grammar mistakes & Misspelled words & Changed (can Trade) to (Cant Trade)
[*]Ultimate Attack Tutorial: Fixed Grammar mistakes & Misspelled words
[*]World Map Tutorial: Fixed Grammar mistakes & Misspelled words
[*]Trade Tutorial: Fixed Misspelled words

[*]UI Tutorial: Changed (Item Your hand) to (Item in Your hand)

And Again, Remember you can always Report any Problem you see and fixes will be made as soon as possible.

notes.title: MOVAFORT Optimization Update #1
notes.notes:
First of all thanks for your patience, The reason why its (Optimization Update #1) because I believe there is more room for improvement in the future, most of the random annoying frame drops are fixed, but it still happens in some cases like at 3:00 when the clock tower rings and when you click save game. You have no idea how heavy it is to save a point in time.

To run the game smoothly install the game system drive (usually C: Driver) and on SSD.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
        [*]When an Animal Parry an Arrow a message will pop-up (The Animal Parried The Arrow)
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
        [*]Animals now have 75% to block an arrow (Instead of 100%) if the player attacked the animal before throwing that arrow
        [*]Loading Screen will now disappear before displaying wake up animation
[/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
[list]
        [*](Crack Texture) will now be loaded one time per game instead of once per biome is loaded to increase Performance
        [*]Loaded items in memory will be loaded in 1 frame instead of (1/16) Frame to prevent frame drops
        [*]if an item was not loaded in memory when chunk is loaded then it will be loaded in 3 frames instead of (1/16) Frame to prevent frame drops
        [*]Robot Texture is now loaded in a number of frames depending on file size instead of 1 frame to prevent frame drops when loading biomes
        [*]Mattress Texture is now loaded in a number of frames depending on file size instead of 1 frame to prevent frame drops when loading biomes
        [*]Tree Texture is now loaded in a number of frames depending on file size instead of 1 frame to prevent frame drops when loading biomes
        [*]Tree Leaves Texture is now loaded in a number of frames depending on file size instead of 1 frame to prevent frame drops when loading biomes
        [*]Tree Leaves Texture are now loaded once per biome instead of twice per biome to increase Performance
        [*]Animal Texture is now loaded in a number of frames depending on file size instead of 1 frame to prevent frame drops when loading biomes
        [*]Animal Uncooked/Cooked Meat Texture is now loaded in a number of frames depending on file size instead of 1 frame to prevent frame drops when loading biomes
        [*]Small/Med/Large Stones/Ores Texture is now loaded in a number of frames depending on file size instead of 1 frame to prevent frame drops when loading biomes
        [*]Boundary Water Map Texture is now loaded in a number of frames depending on file size instead of 1 frame to prevent frame drops when loading biomes
        [*]Closed memory leaks caused by textures not being unloaded with biome unload
        [*]Preloading Chunk Task is now multi-threaded to prevent frame drops
        [*]Chunks getting its nearby Chunks is now x4 faster and no longer cause from drops
        [*](Save and Return to menu) is now much faster
        [*]Unloaded gameplay Music Clip from memory when player return to menu
        [*]Fixed nested Navigation data preventing Navigation from being unloaded from memory after chunk is saved casing memory leak
        [*]Meshes inside Buildings will now be unloaded from memory after Biome no longer have chunks loaded this prevents mesh memory leak
        [*]fixed a frame drop that happens when an animal attack the player
        [*]game will no longer frame drop when destroying a new type of robots
        [*]Chunks Reference data will now be cleared with the chunk to prevent memory leak
        [*]fixed a frame drop that happens when player first hit an enemy or a material
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
        [*]fixed a bug casing Items to stuck on Screen when dragging them ... That's the 5th time I fix this bug you have no idea
        [*]fixed clock tower first floor Button not being saved with chunk
        [*]fixed Books Control Buttons on Screen showing wrong icon when opening book by clicking Right Mouse Button on an item
        [*]fixed Anvil Preview having wrong tool level level when upgrading tools
        [*]fixed a bug that made upgrade events to transform tools instead of upgrading them
        [*]fixed timeline acceleration when a tutorial pop-up on screen
        [*]fixed a bug that appear when Deleting a Notification
        [*]fixed a bug preventing player from stealing from NPC while NPC is dead
[/list]

[h3]Known Bugs[/h3]
-I didn't want to delay this update, but they will be fixed next update
[list]
    [*] You may find 2 NPCs sleeping in the same bed.
[/list]

Remember you can always Report any Problem you see and fixes will be made as soon as possible.
